const allowedModes = new Set(['manual', 'monitor', 'daily']);
const requestedMode = String($input.first().json.mode || 'monitor');
const mode = allowedModes.has(requestedMode) ? requestedMode : 'monitor';

const command = `set -u
printf 'MODE=${mode}\\n'
printf 'TIMESTAMP=%s\\n' "$(date -Iseconds)"
printf 'HOSTNAME_B64=%s\\n' "$(hostname | base64 | tr -d '\\n')"
printf 'OS_B64=%s\\n' "$(. /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null; printf '%s %s' "\${NAME:-Linux}" "\${VERSION_ID:-}" | base64 | tr -d '\\n')"
printf 'KERNEL_B64=%s\\n' "$(uname -r | base64 | tr -d '\\n')"
printf 'IP_B64=%s\\n' "$(hostname -I 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | base64 | tr -d '\\n')"
printf 'UPTIME_SECONDS=%s\\n' "$(cut -d. -f1 /proc/uptime)"
printf 'CPU_CORES=%s\\n' "$(getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN 2>/dev/null || nproc)"
set -- $(head -n1 /proc/stat)
u1=$2; n1=$3; s1=$4; i1=$5; w1=$6; irq1=$7; sirq1=$8; st1=$9
t1=$((u1+n1+s1+i1+w1+irq1+sirq1+st1)); idle1=$((i1+w1))
sleep 1
set -- $(head -n1 /proc/stat)
u2=$2; n2=$3; s2=$4; i2=$5; w2=$6; irq2=$7; sirq2=$8; st2=$9
t2=$((u2+n2+s2+i2+w2+irq2+sirq2+st2)); idle2=$((i2+w2))
printf 'CPU_PERCENT=%s\\n' "$(awk -v dt=$((t2-t1)) -v di=$((idle2-idle1)) 'BEGIN { if (dt > 0) printf "%.1f", (dt-di)*100/dt; else print "0.0" }')"
mem_total=$(awk '/^MemTotal:/ {print $2}' /proc/meminfo)
mem_available=$(awk '/^MemAvailable:/ {print $2}' /proc/meminfo)
printf 'MEM_TOTAL_KB=%s\\n' "$mem_total"
printf 'MEM_AVAILABLE_KB=%s\\n' "$mem_available"
printf 'MEM_PERCENT=%s\\n' "$(awk -v t="$mem_total" -v a="$mem_available" 'BEGIN { if (t > 0) printf "%.1f", (t-a)*100/t; else print "0.0" }')"
printf 'DISK_TOTAL_KB=%s\\n' "$(df -Pk / | awk 'NR==2 {print $2}')"
printf 'DISK_USED_KB=%s\\n' "$(df -Pk / | awk 'NR==2 {print $3}')"
printf 'DISK_AVAILABLE_KB=%s\\n' "$(df -Pk / | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')"
printf 'DISK_PERCENT=%s\\n' "$(df -Pk / | awk 'NR==2 {gsub(/%/, "", $5); print $5}')"
printf 'LOAD_1=%s\\n' "$(awk '{print $1}' /proc/loadavg)"
printf 'LOAD_5=%s\\n' "$(awk '{print $2}' /proc/loadavg)"
printf 'LOAD_15=%s\\n' "$(awk '{print $3}' /proc/loadavg)"
if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  docker_running="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}|{{.Image}}|{{.Label "com.docker.compose.service"}}' 2>/dev/null)"
  docker_all="$(docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}|{{.Image}}|{{.Label "com.docker.compose.service"}}' 2>/dev/null)"
  n8n_running="$(printf '%s\\n' "$docker_running" | awk -F '|' 'tolower($4) == "n8n" || tolower($3) ~ /(^|\\/)n8n([:@]|$)/ || tolower($3) ~ /n8nio\\/n8n/ || tolower($1) == "n8n" {c++} END {print c+0}')"
  n8n_all="$(printf '%s\\n' "$docker_all" | awk -F '|' 'tolower($4) == "n8n" || tolower($3) ~ /(^|\\/)n8n([:@]|$)/ || tolower($3) ~ /n8nio\\/n8n/ || tolower($1) == "n8n"')"
  printf 'DOCKER_ACCESS=1\\n'
  printf 'DOCKER_VERSION_B64=%s\\n' "$(docker version --format '{{.Server.Version}}' 2>/dev/null | base64 | tr -d '\\n')"
  printf 'DOCKER_RUNNING=%s\\n' "$(printf '%s\\n' "$docker_running" | awk 'NF {c++} END {print c+0}')"
  printf 'DOCKER_TOTAL=%s\\n' "$(printf '%s\\n' "$docker_all" | awk 'NF {c++} END {print c+0}')"
  printf 'N8N_RUNNING=%s\\n' "$n8n_running"
  printf 'N8N_CONTAINERS_B64=%s\\n' "$(printf '%s' "$n8n_all" | base64 | tr -d '\\n')"
  printf 'DOCKER_ERROR_B64=\\n'
else
  docker_error="$(docker info 2>&1 | tail -n 3)"
  printf 'DOCKER_ACCESS=0\\n'
  printf 'DOCKER_VERSION_B64=\\n'
  printf 'DOCKER_RUNNING=0\\n'
  printf 'DOCKER_TOTAL=0\\n'
  printf 'N8N_RUNNING=0\\n'
  printf 'N8N_CONTAINERS_B64=\\n'
  printf 'DOCKER_ERROR_B64=%s\\n' "$(printf '%s' "$docker_error" | base64 | tr -d '\\n')"
fi`;

return [{ json: { mode, command } }];

## Configuracao obrigatoria

1. Em **Avaliar e montar mensagem**, troque `SUBSTITUA_PELO_CHAT_ID`.
2. Em **Coletar status via SSH**, selecione uma credencial SSH com chave privada para o Ubuntu host.
3. Em **Enviar para Telegram**, selecione a credencial do bot.
4. Execute **Teste manual**. Se funcionar, salve e publique o workflow.

Os limites tambem ficam no inicio do node **Avaliar e montar mensagem**.

## Comportamento

- Verifica a cada 5 minutos.
- Envia alerta novo e repete a cada 60 minutos enquanto persistir.
- Envia mensagem de recuperacao.
- Envia relatorio diario as 08:00.
- O teste manual sempre envia.

Timezone do workflow: `America/Sao_Paulo`.
